recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source follow-up is recommended unless future generated output regresses from the authoritative 0..* root cardinalities.
issue_request: FHIR-18406 asked whether Resource and DomainResource should display base cardinality 1..1 when usages such as Parameters.parameter.resource can constrain a Resource-typed element to 0..1. The Published/Persuasive STU3 resolution was to correct Resource and DomainResource cardinality to 0..*.
initial_application: The Jira comment identifies commit f8c346570d, which changed the old dictionary generator display from hard-coded 1..1 to 0..* and set generated resource roots to min 0 and max unbounded during validation. That historical application addressed the display/tooling problem rather than leaving a current source hunk to apply.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes Resource and DomainResource as abstract resources. The current Resource and DomainResource StructureDefinition XML differential roots both have min 0 and max *, and Parameters.parameter.resource remains a Resource-typed child element constrained to 0..1. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence, and a Jira text search found only the seed issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the authoritative current source already matches the applied Jira resolution.
